narrow_shared_operation_and_contract: Materialize a redacted sensitive settings value from the secret store, decode UTF-8, and substitute empty string if absent while mapping read failures.
rationale: Both loops independently implement the same lookup/decode/missing-value/error operation inside the same settings materialization flow. Collection shape and key derivation can remain adapters around a narrow secret materializer.
legitimate_variations: Environment uses sensitive plus valueRedacted and retains variable metadata; usage source uses a sentinel and replaces managementKey. Environment errors attach provider/name metadata. These variations must remain.
existing_shared_owner_or_delegation: Both use secretStore and textDecoder. Supplied settingsSecrets context describes mapSettingsSecrets, but these endpoint loops do not delegate their lookup operation to it; context alone does not establish its revision applicability.
uncertainty_and_disagreement: A common operation is supported; identical representation or wholesale loop replacement is not.
